decisions.observation: Caelen's abstraction and recourse contracts made finite decision boundaries inspectable but did not cover color-profile structure or visual communication.
decisions.interpretation: Color transforms can reuse strict typed evidence mechanics only when source credit and domain claims remain separate.
decisions.decision: Build color-profile, transform and accessibility contracts with new operation names, fixtures and hypotheses.
decisions.evidence: 200 immediate-source reviews and 40,000 pairwise bounded comparisons
decisions.rollback: Quarantine any semantic collision and retain zero inherited credit.

decisions.observation: The first freeze quarantined all ten role-deficit variants at 0.857143 similarity.
decisions.interpretation: Renaming an operation is insufficient when the hypothesis remains semantically near its source.
decisions.decision: Rewrite the family around explicit finite profile-release denial without lowering the 0.8 threshold.
decisions.evidence: Retained PRE-N008/PRE-N009 and corrected zero-quarantine audit
decisions.rollback: Restore quarantine and stop x1 if any revised collision remains.

decisions.observation: Thin public tools are safer when their claim surface is narrower than owner-phase executors.
decisions.interpretation: Promotion should consolidate color intake, refusal and provenance without pretending to reproduce the full phase.
decisions.decision: Publish five standalone color-envelope runners with strict unknown-field refusal and authority=false input.
decisions.evidence: Candidate and installed hash parity, Skill Creator validation and runner self-tests
decisions.rollback: Reject non-identical collisions and leave promotion unexecuted.

decisions.observation: A structural positive can coexist with a represented, open or exact-gated disposition.
decisions.interpretation: Implementation correctness and evidentiary disposition are orthogonal.
decisions.decision: Preserve every frozen disposition after typed equality rather than promoting it.
decisions.rollback: Any mismatch becomes open_gap and blocks finalization.
